info.name: Psion (Homebrew)
info.description: Custom Int-based Psion class with psi-powered casting and a Mental Strain overcharge system.
info.author: Eddie Scott

description.p: Hit Dice. d8
Primary Ability. Intelligence
Saving Throws. Intelligence, Wisdom
Armor & Weapons. Light armor, simple weapons
Skills. Choose two from Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Perception, Persuasion

You wield mental “powers” using a pool of Psi Points. Casting a power costs psi points equal to the power’s level (cantrips cost 0). You regain all expended psi points when you finish a long rest. You can’t spend more psi points on a single casting than your Psion level. Your casting ability is Intelligence (save DC = 8 + PB + Int mod; attack = PB + Int mod).

You may enhance a power by taking Strain. Each enhancement adds 1 Strain to your Strain Level. Your safe threshold equals your Int modifier + psion level. When you exceed this threshold, after each power you roll on the Backlash Table; for each point above the threshold, roll an additional time.

ol.li: Neural Overload. Take psychic damage equal to 3 × your Strain Level and until end of your next turn you can’t take reactions and can only take one action (no bonus actions).
Cerebral Rupture. Take psychic damage equal to twice your Psion level and become stunned until the end of your next turn.
Fractured Mind. Disadvantage on Intelligence saving throws until you finish a short or long rest.
Collapse of Will. You fall prone and restrain yourself until the start of your next turn.
Psychic Detonation. All creatures within 10 feet of you take psychic damage equal to 2 × your Strain Level (Con save for half).

description.p: Choose two enhancements at 1st level. You can apply one enhancement when you cast a power by taking 1 Strain:

ul.li: Overpower (1 Strain): Increase all damage dice of this power by one step (d6→d8, d8→d10, etc.).
Psychic Shield (1 Strain): Gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier.
Piercing Thought (1 Strain): Impose disadvantage on one target’s saving throw against this power.
Unnerving Glare (1 Strain): Until the end of your next turn, the target cannot take reactions, and it can either move or take an action on its turn (not both).
Mind Trip (1 Strain): Any creature of your choice within 10 feet of the original target makes a Con save; on a failure it falls prone and takes 1d6 psychic damage (half on a success, no knockdown).

description.p: You learn additional enhancements at levels 3, 6, 10, 14, and 18.

Choose one: quarterstaff, dagger, light crossbow (20 bolts), or sling (20 bullets). Choose one: leather armor or padded armor. Choose one: scholar’s pack or explorer’s pack. You also have a psionic focus (crystal or circlet) and two daggers.

setters.set: Int-based manifester using Psi Points and Strain-fueled Enhancements.

description.p: You cast psionic powers using Psi Points. L1: 4 PP • 3 cantrips known • 4 powers known. Your casting ability is Intelligence.

sheet.description: Psionic casting (Int). L1: PP 4 • 3 cantrips • 4 powers.

description.p: Apply one Enhancement by taking Strain. After exceeding your safe threshold (Int mod + PL), roll on the Backlash Table; roll one extra time for each point above threshold.

sheet.description: Enhance powers by taking Strain; roll backlash over threshold.

description.p: Choose two: Overpower; Psychic Shield; Piercing Thought; Unnerving Glare; Mind Trip.

sheet.description: Choose 2 Enhancements: Overpower; Psychic Shield; Piercing Thought; Unnerving Glare; Mind Trip.
